visualize_matrix_overlay: create a MatrixVisualizer to overlay a scaled matrix onto a BGR image within a bounding box
draw_rectangle_bbox: create a RectangleVisualizer to draw a colored rectangle on a BGR image at a given bounding box
draw_points_on_image: create a PointsVisualizer to draw colored circles at specified coordinates on a BGR image
render_text_on_image: create a TextVisualizer to render styled text with optional fill and frame transparency on a BGR image
compose_multiple_visualizers: create a CompoundVisualizer to chain multiple visualizers and apply them sequentially to a BGR image
